integrity: All mathematical assertions are accompanied by an analytic proof; supplementary finite computations are not treated as proof of universal quantifiers. Publication precedence remains subject to independent verification, especially in classical E-optimal design.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-update worst-direction fractional objective decrease divided by expected work, with fixed positive coordinate costs on real two-dimensional positive-definite quadratics. Not a long-run rate, wall-clock guarantee, adaptive rule, or a result for higher dimensions.
title: A sharp cost–coherence allocation law for two-coordinate quadratic descent
